name: separating hyperplane of maximum margin
mechanism: find the hyperplane that separates two classes with the largest distance to the nearest examples, by solving a quadratic program whose solution depends only on those nearest examples, optionally in a feature space reached through a kernel

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Support Vector Machine (SVM)' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: a set of methods which divide multidimensional data by finding a dividing hyperplane with the maximum margin between the two sets

fails_when: quadratic in examples; kernel choice is the model
